title: RepoSnapshot v3 — Assemble IR
description: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — not read by code (see descriptor.json for the register that IS). In-memory intermediate representation produced by Invoke-Assemble. Successor to the LTS JSON monolith as a DATA STRUCTURE — v3 never emits it as an artifact. Property names are the in-memory PascalCase shape; JSON wire naming and emission-side arrangement (sort/group/shard/idx) are downstream writer concerns and are deliberately NOT described here. Per-field dispositions (core / ingestion / element) are declared in schema/descriptor.json and consumed by rs.core.assemble at import; this file describes the macro-shape (Header / Entries / Skipped / Diagnostics) only. Source of truth: reposnapshot-v3/rs.core.assemble.psm1 (Invoke-Assemble). Design: issues/reposnapshot/design/rs.core.assemble-design.md. Captured 2026-08-09; descriptor deference added 2026-08-15.

Entries.description: Open self-describing property bags in CANONICAL INGESTED ORDER (store order). All sorting/grouping/sharding is the emission-side arrangement layer and is not applied here.

Skipped.description: Pre-chain skips passed through from DispatchOutput.Skipped (e.g. ignore size-cap, FileStatReadFailed). Never entries; distinct from Diagnostics.Routed, which is post-adapt routing.

header.description: RunContext fields stamped VERBATIM (never computed) plus the two assemble-derived facts. EntryCount and Elements are reserved names — a RunContext carrying either causes Invoke-Assemble to throw. RunContext fields are open; the known ones below carry shapes owned by RunContext, not by assemble.

Elements.description: Payload self-description + coverage diagnostics. One key per non-core element name observed across entries; the core fields (RelativePath/NodePath/LastWriteUtc/Content) are excluded.

ConfigEcho.description: effective run configuration echo (RunContext); ancestor of the LTS header params block

GitHistory.description: RunContext, verbatim (never exercised in the LTS selfies)

entry.description: Open element model: a self-describing bag. The core fields are guaranteed on code-track entries under the default LeanPayload routing; any number of additional elements may be attached by chain processors (e.g. Attributes, Processing, Operations) and flow through assemble with zero per-element code. EXCLUDED by assemble: every field with scope=ingestion in schema/descriptor.json (the authoritative list — not repeated here). Under LeanPayload, ReadError is also excluded (routed to Diagnostics); under KeepContentless it is retained and Content may be absent/empty.

RelativePath.description: root-anchored, forward-slash; the payload path column (LTS row 'path')

NodePath.description: directory node path; structure encoded flatly for reader token economy

Content.description: PROCESSED content (post-chain), NOT the on-disk original. Under LeanPayload always a non-empty string (null/empty routed out); under KeepContentless may be null/empty/absent.

Processing.description: Chain-ordered processing trail (processor + ops). Known element; item shape owned by the emitting processors. Feeds the payload channel manifest (which channels the payload carries).

Operations.description: rs-psstrip operations record, promoted to an attached element (open element model). Shape owned by rs-psstrip.

attributes.description: Content-form statistics over the PROCESSED Content. SpanBytes is the UTF-8 byte span of processed content (payload byte semantics) — NOT on-disk SizeBytes, and NOT the writer-side encoded row 'length'. Produced by processors/rs-attributes.ps1 and surfaced through the open element model (assemble does not own this shape). Optional on any entry — absent when the entry carries no usable Content (e.g. thread envelopes). 4-decimal rounding matches LTS for the golden comparison; CompressionRatio deliberately diverges (LTS emits 0 for >100-char entries via a disposed-stream defect).

SpanBytes.description: UTF-8 byte span of processed content (payload navigation + packing semantics)

CompressionRatio.description: GZip length / raw length; 4-decimal. 1.0 for content of 100 chars or fewer (the >100 guard).

LineStats.description: Line-length statistics. Lines split on LF only, so a trailing CR is included on CRLF content — deliberate LTS parity.

Median.description: lower-median (index floor(n/2) of the sorted lengths)

diagnostics.description: Never rendered into payloads — the feed for the diagnostic sidecar (payload doctrine).

Routed.description: Entries diverted from the payload by LeanPayload routing (or a null dispatch result).

Index.description: position in the dispatch Results (ingested order)

Reason.description: Known values: NullResult, ChainHalt, NoContent, EmptyContent, EmptyFile, EmptiedByProcessing — or a read-failure kind string (from the item's ReadError).

Errors.description: Dispatch-level error strings (colonel Streams -> ingest projection).
